notes: Primary sources verified by title. Original: author-hosted published PDF. Replication: authors’ full DOCX linked from assigned OSF registration, item36. Effect sizes and p values copied as printed, without correction or conversion. DOCX text parse loses eta glyph (rendered 2p). Original analytic n not inferred from degrees of freedom; replication final sample 743 not assumed to equal each test’s analytic n.
